summary.en: A clean-lined vanity arrangement for a coordinated bathroom brief.
summary.zh: 用简洁的柜体与镜面组合协调浴室布局。

description.en:
A white wall-mounted vanity design shown with basin and mirror arrangements. The raised cabinet profile leaves the floor line visible and gives the bathroom a lighter appearance.
Confirm the basin, mirror, fixing requirements, cabinet materials and dimensions as part of the quotation.
description.zh:
白色悬挂式浴室柜配有盆体及镜面方案展示。柜体抬离地面，使地面线条保持可见，视觉更轻盈。
报价时请一并确认盆体、镜面、安装固定要求、柜体材料及尺寸。

en: White appearance with basin and mirror examples.
Cabinet, basin and mirror inclusion confirmed separately.
zh: 白色方案，配有盆体与镜面示例。
柜体、盆体及镜面的供货范围分别确认。

applications.zh: 浴室家具项目，需确认材料适用性与安装要求
